items.title: FAA Proposes $170,000 Fine Against Sonoma County Airport for Alleged Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting and Wildlife Inspection Violations
items.summary: WASHINGTON — The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposes a $170,000 civil penalty against the Charles M. Schultz Sonoma County Airport (STS) in California for allegedly violating aircraft rescue and firefighting and wildlife inspection requirements. The FAA alleges STS did not provide the required personnel and vehicles for aircraft rescue and firefighting coverage for two passenger flights in March 2025 as required by its FAA approved Airport Certification Manual, nor did STS notify the…

items.title: FAA Proposes $58,000 Fine Against Arapahoe Flight Club for Alleged Drug and Alcohol Testing Violations
items.summary: WASHINGTON — The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposes a $58,000 civil penalty against Arapaho Flight Club of Colorado Springs, Colorado, for allegedly violating FAA drug and alcohol testing program regulations.
